name: Fuel Run
design_intent: TUTORIAL 4 of 4. Lesson: PADS REFILL THE TANK — recharge along the way. A tank_run-shaped A->B crossing over a lethal void, tuned so ONE tank cannot fly the whole span: total crossing ~3600px of powered flight > 2660px (one full tank), so the player MUST touch the stepping pads (+20 fuel per bounce, fuel_per_bounce) to bank range — the exact recharge loop the whole game economy runs on. Four 700px gaps: 700 > 527 (max zero-boost spring drift) and > 395 (trampoline drift), so every gap is flight-required (a bounce alone falls in). Per-leg cost ~700px at 760 px/s ~= 0.95s ~= 27 fuel vs +20 refund per pad touch plus the double-bounce trick (bounce the same pad twice to bank +40) — the course closes comfortably for a player who touches pads and starves a player who tries to skip them, which IS the lesson. First tutorial with a real void: falls are free respawns at the start gate (v10), introducing death-space safely.
hint: PADS REFILL YOUR TANK — TOUCH EVERY ONE
